audit_protocol_delta.reason: S18-S34 use the corrected paragraph protocol; defended content is not rewritten for cosmetic churn.

carry_forward_constraints: S35 must not treat S34 metrics, calibration or threshold promotion as green. S34 remains REPAIR_REQUIRED and its outputs are evidence only when they pass the repaired gates.
Every S35 explanation/fairness/slice artifact must trace to one out-of-sample prediction table keyed by sample/pair id and bound to run/model/feature-set/split/target/horizon provenance.
Never consume confusion, precision/recall/F-score, Brier or AP from zip-truncated/misaligned vectors. Require exact cardinality, sample-id equality, finite scores and validated binary labels.
Tied scores must use threshold-grouped AP semantics and a stable/versioned top-k tie policy; input order must not determine ranking metrics or who enters review.
Fairness/slice metrics need support, prevalence and explicit undefined-state handling. Tiny or zero-support slices cannot produce green/red fairness conclusions.

If S35 reuses imbalance handling, weights/resampling must occur only inside training folds while preserving both class support and the declared entity/group constraints. Plain StratifiedKFold does not solve pair-endpoint leakage.

Calibration fit, calibration evaluation, threshold/abstain tuning and final test remain separate stages. S35 explanations must refer to predictions from the frozen final policy, not to rows used to tune it.
Operational probabilities remain full-precision finite values in [0,1]. Never let display rounding change a threshold, calibration metric or explanation route.

Threshold/abstain policy must be an immutable manifest bound to model run, calibrator, cost matrix, capacity, prevalence, tuning snapshot and tie policy; a `thr-vN` string or default low/high pair is insufficient.
`abstain` must have an explicit operational destination and workload meaning. S35 must distinguish review, abstain/request-more-evidence and skip when computing coverage or explaining queue outcomes.
S35 slice/equity analysis must be computed from real prediction rows with support and provenance, not from slogans, handwritten indices or hard-coded booleans.
Structural graph/entity features remain associations/signals. Coefficients, SHAP or feature attribution must never be rewritten as causal evidence of fraud, parentesco, culpability or intent.

Keep pytest regressions for AP ties, unequal prediction/gold cardinality, invalid k/n_pos, Brier range/boundaries, calibration split disjointness, threshold no-review/no-feasible cases, NaN probabilities and inverted abstain bands.
Preserve the distinction between ranking quality, probability calibration, decision-policy utility and selective/abstention coverage; one metric cannot substitute for the others.
Inherited S26-S34 regression debt remains active. Explainability cannot legitimize contaminated features, leaked baselines, invalid metrics or a policy that was tuned on its final test.
